definitions.pairedSeeds: Ability, individual skill, difficulty and keeper skill share the same release seed and shooter identity. Canonical outcomes may diverge physically after launch.
definitions.horizontalError: Absolute sampled target-plane coordinate error multiplied by goal half-width (3.66m). It is intended execution error, separate from physical flight height/drag and keeper intervention.
definitions.verticalError: Absolute sampled target-plane coordinate error multiplied by goal height (2.44m). Negative aiming heights can bounce into goal.
definitions.onTarget: Final public result goal or save. ProjectedOnTarget is unobstructed physical goal-plane classification.
definitions.blocks: Final first physical block includes passive keeper-body blocks. GoalkeeperContacts includes catch/parry/failed_save contacts.
definitions.rangeMatrix: Keeper displaced laterally 12m to isolate execution with an open goal. Context and keeper matrices use the named normal geometry.
definitions.freeKick: Existing applyRestartScenario free_kick_close establishes the actual taker, defensive wall, keeper and release lifecycle. Only existing shot actions are exercised; no new restart UI/choreography.
definitions.selection: Top-ranked legal shot family among canonical AI actions; this measures family preference, not frequency of choosing shots over passes.
definitions.reactionReach: Release-time advisory canonical keeper projection; actual contact and outcomes still come from fixed-step locomotion/CCD.
